name: Billy Loomis

skins.name: Stu
skins.lore: The Stu skin represents Stu Macher, Billy Loomis' best friend and accomplice in the original Scream film. Beneath his goofy and energetic personality, Stu was revealed to be one of the first Ghostface killers.

skins.name: Jill
skins.lore: The Jill skin represents Jill Roberts from Scream 4, a manipulative Ghostface killer obsessed with fame and becoming the sole survivor of her own horror story.

skins.name: Roman
skins.lore: The Roman skin represents Roman Bridger from Scream 3, the director secretly responsible for orchestrating many events of the franchise while operating as Ghostface.

skins.name: Amber
skins.lore: The Amber skin represents Amber Freeman from Scream 5, a violent Ghostface killer heavily inspired by horror fandom obsession and the original Woodsboro murders.

skins.name: Ethan
skins.lore: The Ethan skin represents Ethan Landry from Scream 6, one of the Ghostface killers who participated in a revenge-driven murder spree tied to Richie Kirsch's family.

skins.name: Hallucination
skins.lore: The Hallucination skin represents Billy Loomis appearing as a disturbing hallucination years after his death, showing a more pale, damaged, and unsettling version of himself.

lore: Billy Loomis is one of the main killers from the Scream horror franchise. Manipulative, violent, and calculating, he hides behind the Ghostface identity to terrorize victims using stealth, psychological intimidation, and brutal knife attacks.
